Turn this page into a mobile app

This public edition of BingeStory is a normal website — which means it can be wrapped into a real iOS and Android app with Median.co, a website-to-app converter. No code needed.

1 · Copy this site's addressOpen BingeStory Public in your browser and copy its web address (URL) from the address bar.
2 · Paste it into MedianGo to median.co, start a new app, and paste the BingeStory address. Median builds a native app around this site in its App Studio.
3 · Make it yoursSet the app name to BingeStory, add the icon and splash screen, and turn on push notifications and native navigation.
4 · PublishTest free in Median's simulator, then publish to Google Play and the App Store from the same project.

What it costs: Median is free to try (with “Powered by Median.co” branding and 1-minute simulator sessions). Removing the branding is Starter — $229 one-time, then $179/year. The stores charge their own fees: Apple Developer $99/year and Google Play $25 one-time.
